summary: Dreamland Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an October 9, 2026 securities purchase agreement with CEO and director Ms. Seto Wai Yue. The private placement comprises 300,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$2.00 per share (US$600,000 gross) plus 300,000 unlisted warrants, each exercisable for four Class A shares at US$0.01 until the fifth anniversary, a deeply dilutive insider structure. Disinterested directors approved, Ms. Seto recused. Issued under Regulation S to a non-U.S. person, no shareholder vote was held under Nasdaq home-country practice. Watch for warrant exercise overhang and potential related-party governance concerns.
